cells.forex: A deposit per trade set by the broker; falling too low can bring a [[margin-call]] and a [[stop-out]].
cells.stocks: None if you pay in full; a borrowing account has margin rules of its own.
cells.penny_stocks: Usually paid in full; many brokers restrict borrowing against these shares.
cells.commodities: Depends on the route: futures margin, broker contract margin, or full payment for a fund.
cells.futures: [[initial-margin|Initial]] and [[maintenance-margin|maintenance]] margin per contract, with daily [[mark-to-market]] settlement.

caveat: Margin rules are set by exchanges, brokers and regulators and can be raised at short notice. In every market, required margin is a deposit, not the most you can lose.
